data.rationale: The proposal gets the same procedure in the right order (weather search, 10-day forecast, BBC "<city> strike", compose Heads-up mail, discard) with the city and date parameters correct. But it names "recipient email" instead of traveler, so the {traveler}@example.com pattern and the "Hi {traveler}" greeting are lost. It also omits the exact body template, says "a relevant article" instead of the first result, and leaves out the Mail tab and the To/Subject/Body clicks, which is vague enough to hurt automation.
